title: Expose desktop project operations
responsibility: Connects desktop project, planning, evidence and agent operations to the selected project session.

inputs.name: desktopBridge.context
inputs.description: The project session, provider discovery, run service, folder chooser and optional session-liveness check. The folder chooser returns a directory or null for cancellation.

outputs.name: desktopBridge
outputs.description: A desktop operations object without the run-event subscription. Most operations assert any supplied project identity and track a pending request until completion; open, select and list operations are delegated separately. Planning writes are serialized per repository. Opening returns the selected project snapshot or null when cancelled.

outputs.name: projectWork
outputs.description: Reads one committed task-queue snapshot for the exact selected local project; rechecks project identity, root and client liveness before returning.

outputs.name: selectFeaturePlan
outputs.description: For the selected local project, serialize the action under the repository lease and select an option only for the current writable source and exact latest plan digest.

outputs.name: approveFeaturePlan
outputs.description: For the selected local project, serialize readiness-checked approval and submission of the exact approved task records. Does not start a provider.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Returned operations can reject stale project context and underlying service failures. Planning changes refuse a busy repository or ended client. Opening a thread refuses an unknown entity; source reading refuses a draft without registered source. Hosted connection refuses when sign-in is not configured.

errors.name: foreign, changed or unavailable project
errors.description: Rejects without returning work from another project.

errors.name: feature plan action failure
errors.description: Rejects stale, foreign, read-only or unavailable context and propagates readiness or admission errors. An approval may already be committed if task submission later fails.
